text:
maya: Opening a small refresh PR for the hello-breeze quickstart. Goal: add OAuth Device Code flow example (for CLI/devs who can't run a browser), keep the existing PKCE section, and swap out cookie-helper for the decklink CLI. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120. Need: quick snippet check (py + ts), decklink install checksum, and a Linux smoke test. cc @trent @anu :wave:

trent: Love the device-flow addition. For the TS snippet please show using the decklink store command instead of localStorage. Also list env vars: REDWOOD_CLIENT_ID, REDWOOD_AUTH_DOMAIN, DECKLINK_PATH. I'll draft the TS snippet if you want.

anu: I'll review the Python snippet. Please add a short note that device flow is recommended only for local/dev tooling (not for long-lived server auth). Also add SDK compatibility (>= 0.9.1) and link to the migration guide for cookie-helper -> decklink.

maya: Thanks — adding the SDK note and short security guidance. Will include decklink checksum from the releases page. Pushed initial commits.

ci-bot: CI: docs-build passed for PR #5120 — preview: https://deploy-preview-5120--redwood-docs.netlify.app/hello-breeze.html

trent: Pushed a quick TS snippet to the PR. Example uses fetch to poll the token endpoint and then runs `./decklink store token.json` to save creds. Also tweaked wording to clarify device flow rate limits.

anu: Python snippet pushed — shows requests polling loop and uses subprocess to call decklink. Added a tiny migration one-liner: `cookie-helper migrate-to decklink` (links to migration guide).

maya: Nice. QA: can someone run the linux smoke (Ubuntu 22.04)? Steps are in PR: npm ci; npm run dev; follow device code flow example (open device.verification_uri in phone/browser or use decklink to fetch code); poll and store token; open http://localhost:3000 and confirm greeting renders.

qa-joel: Running smoke now. Followed the device flow via my phone, decklink saved token, app shows "Welcome, dev". Left a tiny wording nit about the rate-limit guidance.

maya: Applying the nit and adding the checksum line. Thanks all — planning to merge after spellcheck. I'll post a short heads-up in #all-hands and add the new device-flow snippet to the quickstart checklist. :rocket:
